subject: Next steps — technical walkthrough & stakeholder confirmation
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@medsync.health>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@medsync.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 10:21:00 -0400
Subject: Next steps — technical walkthrough & stakeholder confirmation

Hi Tom / Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and helpful context on the latency and audit-log needs you mentioned. Quick recap of the key items we noted on the call:

- Primary goal: replace batch inference pipeline with a low-latency serving path for clinical summarization (target P95 < 250ms).
- Data residency: production will need EU-region controls for a subset of patient records (we discussed encryption + KMS).
- Audit/compliance: SOC2-style access logs and retention options are required for the first release.

Proposed next step: a 60-minute technical walkthrough with your engineering and security stakeholders to cover architecture, performance profile, and deployment options (hosted vs. private). Suggested agenda: 1) brief recap + requirements (10m), 2) runtime architecture and quant/latency tradeoffs (25m), 3) deployment/ops (15m), 4) Q&A and mutual action items (10m).

I have two windows that work on our side next week (all times ET):
- Tue Aug 24, 11:00–12:00 ET
- Wed Aug 25, 14:00–15:00 ET

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side will join (names/titles)? If you prefer a different time, send a couple options and we’ll adapt. We’ll send a calendar invite with a Meet link and attach a short mutual-action-plan doc ahead of the session.

Attachments: discovery-notes-20260816.pdf (summary from today) and redwood-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (draft).

Thanks — looking forward to lining up the tech group.

Best,
Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | (415) 555-0126

Attendees from MedSync:

- Marcus Diaz (Lead ML Engineer)

Two quick asks before we lock the slot:

2) Do you have a short SLA slide or notes we can review prior to the call?

Prefer Google Meet link if possible. If Wed 14:00 ET is locked, please send the invite and we’ll confirm the final attendee roster.
